user_saw: GPT-6.1 Sol was missing from the managed Codex model picker even for users with access to it.
summary: The fix upgrades managed Codex to 0.159.1 so its catalog includes GPT-6.1 Sol, refreshes the protocol schemas so Guardian denials settle promptly, and switches timeout diagnostics to the registration SDK.
reasoning: I checked that #160487 upgraded managed Codex from 0.155.1 to 0.158.0 before #161400 added GPT-6.1 Sol to OpenClaw’s provider metadata. The PR’s isolated `model/list` comparison found the new model only in 0.159.1, so the provider rollout exposed a gap in the older upstream catalog. The fix’s test also shows that the older schema rejected a completion carrying the new `tooManyDenials` error.
